messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Does metformin work for weight loss?
:
Yes.
Metformin can lead to a modest weight loss.
Results vary.
The weight loss from Metformin is generally smaller than what is seen with medications specifically approved for weight loss.
In the landmark Diabetes Prevention Program (DPP), participants taking metformin lost more weight than those on placebo.
The DPP was a randomized controlled trial in people at high risk for diabetes.
Metformin patients lost 2.7% of body weight after one year.
This was compared to 0.43% for placebo.
Metformin patients also lost 2.1% of body weight after two years.
This was compared to essentially no change (0.02%) for placebo.
29% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
Just 13% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight after one year.
This gap held up at the two-year mark.
At the two-year mark, 26% of people on metformin lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
At the two-year mark, 14% of people on placebo lost at least 5% of their starting body weight.
Triplet: ["Metformin", "has weight loss result", "26% lost at least 5% body weight after two years"]

The relation 'has weight loss result' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject entity is associated with the specific weight loss outcome or result described by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'related to': The subject entity is associated with or connected to the medical condition or entity specified by the object entity.
B. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
C. 'are being treated with': The subject entity is receiving treatment with the substance or therapy specified by the object entity.
D. 'is a': The subject entity is categorized as the object entity.
E. 'has clinical trial result': The subject drug has demonstrated or shown the clinical trial outcome specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
